records.jp: こういう風に改造して使ってると、<CR>ここが学校の教室だって忘れそうになるよね
records.en_original: Sometimes, I forget this is a classroom because of how much we changed the school.
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes, I forget this is a classroom because of how much we changed the school.
records.en: After remodeling it and using it like this,<CR>it's easy to forget this is still a classroom.

records.jp: ふふ、たまには勉強してみる？
records.en_original: Hehe. Maybe we should study every now and then.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. Maybe we should study every now and then.
records.en: Hehe. Maybe we should study every now and then.

records.jp: こころが先生ならいいかも
records.en_original: Only if you teach me!
records.en_auxiliary: Only if you teach me!
records.en: Only if you teach me!

records.jp: うーん？　わたしが教えられることなんてないよ
records.en_original: Hmm. I don't know if there's much I can teach you.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. I don't know if there's much I can teach you.
records.en: Hmm. I don't know if there's much I can teach you.

records.jp: いいのいいの。こころが先生、っていうシチュだけで<CR>ちょっとやる気出るから
records.en_original: That's totally fine! Just the idea of having you as my teacher gives me the motivation I need.
records.en_auxiliary: That's totally fine! Just the idea of having you as my teacher gives me the motivation I need.
records.en: That's totally fine! Just the idea of having you as my teacher<CR>gives me the motivation I need.

records.jp: ね、こころ先生！
records.en_original: Please, Miss Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Please, Miss Kokoro?
records.en: Please, Kokoro-sensei?

records.jp: えっと……なんかくすぐったいね、その呼び方。<CR>やっぱりやめよ
records.en_original: Um... It feels a little weird being called that. Let's not.
records.en_auxiliary: Um... It feels a little weird being called that. Let's not.
records.en: Um... Being called that feels kind of embarrassing.<CR>Actually, let's stop.

records.jp: 残念だなー
records.en_original: Aww, man...
records.en_auxiliary: Aww, man...
records.en: Aww, man...

records.jp: こころがクラスメイトなら勉強も捗るかも
records.en_original: I bet I'd learn more with a classmate like you.
records.en_auxiliary: I bet I'd learn more with a classmate like you.
records.en: I bet I'd learn more with a classmate like you.

records.jp: それって関係ある？
records.en_original: Would that really make any difference?
records.en_auxiliary: Would that really make any difference?
records.en: Would that really make any difference?

records.jp: こころなら色々勉強教えてくれそうだし、<CR>やる気も出そうだなあーって
records.en_original: I was just thinking that you seem like you'd help me learn things I don't understand...
records.en_auxiliary: I was just thinking that you seem like you'd help me learn things I don't understand...
records.en: I figured you'd be able to teach me all sorts of things, Kokoro,<CR>and help me feel more motivated.

records.jp: ……宿題も写させてくれそうだし
records.en_original: ...and let me copy your homework.
records.en_auxiliary: ...and let me copy your homework.
records.en: ...and let me copy your homework.

records.jp: それは自分の力でやらないとダメ
records.en_original: That's something you need to do on your own.
records.en_auxiliary: That's something you need to do on your own.
records.en: That's something you need to do on your own.

records.jp: えー、ダメかあ……
records.en_original: Aww, I tried...
records.en_auxiliary: Aww, I tried...
records.en: Aww, I tried...

records.jp: ふふ。でも、わたしも愛央ちゃんとクラスメイトなら<CR>嬉しかったな
records.en_original: Hehe. But I think it would have been fun if we were classmates too.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. But I think it would have been fun if we were classmates too.
records.en: Hehe. But I would have been happy<CR>if you and I had been classmates, Ao-chan.

records.jp: こころって好きな教科とかある？<CR>苦手な科目でも良いけど
records.en_original: What's your favorite subject, Kokoro? Or your least favorite?
records.en_auxiliary: What's your favorite subject, Kokoro? Or your least favorite?
records.en: What's your favorite subject, Kokoro?<CR>Or your least favorite?

records.jp: うーん……国語とかかなあ。逆に数学は苦手。<CR>愛央ちゃんは？
records.en_original: Hmm... I like Japanese. I never liked math, though. What about you, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I like Japanese. I never liked math, though. What about you, Ao?
records.en: Hmm... I like Japanese. I never liked math, though.<CR>What about you, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 私も国語は好きかな。こころはなんで国語好きなの？
records.en_original: Japanese was one of my better subjects too. What made it your favorite?
records.en_auxiliary: Japanese was one of my better subjects too. What made it your favorite?
records.en: Japanese was one of my better subjects too. What made it your favorite?

records.jp: わたしの学校の国語の先生が、結構面白い人でね
records.en_original: My teacher was really fun.
records.en_auxiliary: My teacher was really fun.
records.en: My teacher was really fun.

records.jp: 元々役者を目指してたとかで、<CR>すっごく感情豊かに朗読してくれるの。プロ並み
records.en_original: He was a former actor and would be really dramatic when he read aloud. Like professional level.
records.en_auxiliary: He was a former actor and would be really dramatic when he read aloud. Like professional level.
records.en: Apparently he originally wanted to become an actor,<CR>so he read aloud with incredible emotion. Like a professional.

records.jp: へー、プロ並みの朗読かあ……
records.en_original: Pro-level storyteller, huh.
records.en_auxiliary: Pro-level storyteller, huh.
records.en: Pro-level storyteller, huh.

records.jp: そうそう。それが楽しみだったんだよね
records.en_original: Exactly. I always looked forward to that.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly. I always looked forward to that.
records.en: Exactly. I always looked forward to that.

records.jp: でも、内容によっては<CR>すっごく眠くなっちゃうこともあったなあ……
records.en_original: But depending on the text, I'd get really sleepy too...
records.en_auxiliary: But depending on the text, I'd get really sleepy too...
records.en: But depending on the material,<CR>sometimes it made me incredibly sleepy...

records.jp: あー、それはありそうだね……
records.en_original: Ah, I can see that happening.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I can see that happening.
records.en: Ah, I can see that happening.

records.jp: 私も数学苦手ー……。<CR>なんか延々と呪文聞かされてるみたいで
records.en_original: I was no good at math either. It's like the teacher was speaking in a whole other language.
records.en_auxiliary: I was no good at math either. It's like the teacher was speaking in a whole other language.
records.en: I was no good at math either.<CR>It's like the teacher was speaking in a whole other language.

records.jp: うんうん。頭が考えるのをやめちゃう……
records.en_original: Totally. My brain just shuts down.
records.en_auxiliary: Totally. My brain just shuts down.
records.en: Totally. My brain just shuts down.

records.jp: 特に午後の授業はよく寝ちゃってたなあ
records.en_original: I always fell asleep during afternoon classes.
records.en_auxiliary: I always fell asleep during afternoon classes.
records.en: I always fell asleep during afternoon classes.

records.jp: ごはん食べた後は眠くなっちゃうよね
records.en_original: After lunch is always the sleepiest time of the day.
records.en_auxiliary: After lunch is always the sleepiest time of the day.
records.en: After lunch is always the sleepiest time of the day.

records.jp: 授業中の居眠りって、<CR>どうしてあんなに気持ち良いんだろう……
records.en_original: I wonder why sleeping during class feels so good...
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder why sleeping during class feels so good...
records.en: I wonder why sleeping<CR>during class feels so good...

records.jp: つらーい勉強から解放されるからかなあ。<CR>……いや、辛さを先送りしてるだけなんだけどさ
records.en_original: Maybe because it frees you from the horrors of studying. Though, it just makes things harder later...
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe because it frees you from the horrors of studying. Though, it just makes things harder later...
records.en: Maybe because it frees you from all that awful studying.<CR>...Though really, you're only putting the pain off until later.

records.jp: 気持ちよくって、<CR>つい放課後まで寝ちゃうときとかあったなあ
records.en_original: It feels so good, one time I even slept all the way until school ended.
records.en_auxiliary: It feels so good, one time I even slept all the way until school ended.
records.en: It feels so good,<CR>one time I even slept all the way until school ended.

records.jp: ええ！？　そこまで！？<CR>だいたい誰かが気づいて起こしてくれない？
records.en_original: That long?! Didn't anyone come to wake you up?
records.en_auxiliary: That long?! Didn't anyone come to wake you up?
records.en: That long?!<CR>Didn't anyone come to wake you up?

records.jp: んー……誰も起こしてくれなかったんだよね。<CR>起きたらもう教室に誰もいなくて……
records.en_original: Hmm... Nobody bothered to wake me. When I finally did wake up, the classroom was empty.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Nobody bothered to wake me. When I finally did wake up, the classroom was empty.
records.en: Hmm... Nobody bothered to wake me. When I finally<CR>did wake up, the classroom was empty.

records.jp: きっと、みんなこころに気を遣ったんだね。<CR>あんまり幸せそうに寝てるから……
records.en_original: I guess you must have been sleeping so peacefully that no one wanted to bother you.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess you must have been sleeping so peacefully that no one wanted to bother you.
records.en: Everyone must have been considerate of you, Kokoro.<CR>You probably looked far too happy sleeping...

records.jp: そうなのかなあ……。<CR>自分の寝顔なんて見ないからわからないけど
records.en_original: I wonder... I've never seen what I look like when I sleep so I can't say.
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder... I've never seen what I look like when I sleep so I can't say.
records.en: I wonder... I've never<CR>seen what I look like when I sleep so I can't say.

records.jp: 今度写真に撮っておいてあげようか？
records.en_original: Want me to take a picture?
records.en_auxiliary: Want me to take a picture?
records.en: Want me to take a picture?

records.jp: んー……恥ずかしいからダメ
records.en_original: Mm... No thanks, that sounds pretty embarrassing.
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... No thanks, that sounds pretty embarrassing.
records.en: Mm... No thanks, that sounds pretty embarrassing.

records.jp: ちょっと待って。それってさ、<CR>何か事件に巻き込まれた可能性はないかな？
records.en_original: Wait a minute. Is it possible you were involved in some kind of...incident?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait a minute. Is it possible you were involved in some kind of...incident?
records.en: Wait a minute. Is it possible<CR>you were involved in some kind of...incident?

records.jp: 事件？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: ズバリ、ＵＦＯだよ
records.en_original: An alien abduction, of course!
records.en_auxiliary: An alien abduction, of course!
records.en: An alien abduction, of course!

records.jp: ゆー……？
records.en_original: An alien wha—?
records.en_auxiliary: An alien wha—?
records.en: An alien wha—?

records.jp: 宇宙人がＵＦＯで地球人をさらって、人体実験してる<CR>っていう話がよくあるじゃん
records.en_original: You've heard stories about UFOs abducting people and performing experiments on them, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You've heard stories about UFOs abducting people and performing experiments on them, right?
records.en: You've heard stories about aliens abducting people in UFOs<CR>and experimenting on them, right?

records.jp: こころはきっと、午後の授業の間にＵＦＯにさらわれて<CR>なにか機械を埋め込まれたりしたんだよ！
records.en_original: You must have been abducted during your afternoon classes and implanted with some kind of probe!
records.en_auxiliary: You must have been abducted during your afternoon classes and implanted with some kind of probe!
records.en: You must have been abducted by a UFO during the afternoon class<CR>and had some kind of device implanted in you!

records.jp: ……もしかして、わたしの首のところにある<CR>謎のでっぱりって……
records.en_original: Could that be where this weird bump on my neck is from...?
records.en_auxiliary: Could that be where this weird bump on my neck is from...?
records.en: ...Could that explain<CR>the mysterious bump on my neck...?

records.jp: うそ！　あんの！？
records.en_original: No way! What bump?!
records.en_auxiliary: No way! What bump?!
records.en: No way! What bump?!

records.jp: ……ふふ、冗談。さすがにＵＦＯはないと思うよ
records.en_original: Hehe... Just kidding. I'm pretty sure there was no UFO.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... Just kidding. I'm pretty sure there was no UFO.
records.en: Hehe... Just kidding. I'm pretty sure there was no UFO.

records.jp: だよねー……
records.en_original: Right...
records.en_auxiliary: Right...
records.en: Right...

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
